description_clean:
Seit der Übernahme durch die CHAPTERS Group AG im Jahr 2025 baut die Linear Service GmbH neben ihrem etablierten Kernsystem für Vereinsverwaltung und Buchhaltung ein komplett neues Cloud-Produkt auf. Das bestehende System bleibt – es läuft weiter und wird von unseren Kunden aus Vereinen, Verbänden und Schulen täglich genutzt. Parallel dazu entsteht auf der grünen Wiese eine moderne Cloud-Produktlinie, von Anfang an mit agentenbasierten AI-Features (Chatbot, Copilot, MCP) gedacht. Dahinter stehen 35 Jahre Erfahrung und ein treuer Kundenstamm – vor uns liegt eine agentenbasierte Zukunft, die wir jetzt gestalten.
Für dieses neue Produkt suchen wir einen Junior Developer (m/w/d), der nicht mit jahrelanger Erfahrung kommt, sondern mit der richtigen Haltung: Du entwickelst von Anfang an AI-first – Coding-Agenten sind für dich kein Hilfsmittel, sondern dein Standard-Workflow – und du willst lernen, wie man Agenten nicht nur nutzt, sondern selbst baut und orchestriert.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen und wächst Schritt für Schritt vom Frontend über APIs bis zur Datenbank in die gesamte Plattform hinein. Das Next.js-Ökosystem musst du noch nicht blind beherrschen – du musst es lernen wollen.
Aufgaben

Feature-Entwicklung: Umsetzung klar abgegrenzter Features in unserer neuen Next.js-Cloud-Plattform (React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL) – mit Mentoring, wachsender Eigenverantwortung und Code-Reviews durch den CTO.
AI-First Development: Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding-Agenten (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot o. ä.), beherrschst Planung, Delegation und Review von agentengeneriertem Code und hilfst uns, unsere AI-Entwicklungsworkflows weiter zu verbessern.
Agenten-Orchestrierung: Mitarbeit an unseren AI-Features – Tool-Anbindungen über MCP, Agent-Flows mit LangGraph, Prompt-Design, Evals und Guardrails für Chatbot und Copilot.
Frontend: Moderne, responsive Benutzeroberflächen mit React/Next.js bauen.
Backend-Grundlagen: API-Endpunkte und Datenbankabfragen umsetzen und dabei Schritt für Schritt Full-Stack-Kompetenz aufbauen.
Qualität & Dokumentation: Tests schreiben, Features dokumentieren – so, dass auch KI-Agenten damit arbeiten können.

Qualifikation

Tech-Stack: Solide Basis in JavaScript/TypeScript und erste praktische Erfahrung mit React und Next.js – aus Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, Bootcamp oder eigenen Projekten. SQL und git sitzen.
AI-First-Mindset (Muss): Du programmierst bereits mit KI-gestützten Tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot etc.) und kannst zeigen, was du damit gebaut hast.
Bereitschaft zur Agenten-Orchestrierung (Muss): Du willst verstehen, wie LLM-Agenten funktionieren – Tool Calling, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, Prompting, Evaluation – und hast idealerweise schon eigene kleine Agenten, Chatbots oder MCP-Server gebaut.
Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium (Informatik o. ä.), Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker/in – oder Quereinstieg mit nachweisbarem Portfolio.
Lernkurve: Hohe Eigeninitiative, schnelle Einarbeitung, Freude daran, aus Reviews und Fehlern zu lernen.
Sprache & Rechtliches: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland.
Nice-to-have: PostgreSQL, Next.js App Router, Erfahrung mit LangGraph/LangChain in einem eigenen Projekt, Open-Source-Beiträge, Grundkenntnisse in der Buchhaltung oder Vereinsarbeit.

Benefits

Mentoring: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CTO, regelmäßige Code-Reviews, steile Lernkurve.
Freier Gestaltungsspielraum: Volle Freiheit bei der Wahl deines Development-Setups und deiner bevorzugten Coding-Agenten.
Echte Grüne Wiese: Keine Altlasten – du baust von Anfang an an einem neuen Cloud-Produkt mit.
100 % Flexibilität: Komplett remote-fähig, flexible Zeiteinteilung; Büro in Berlin Mitte, wenn du magst.
Mobilität: Deutschlandticket wird übernommen.
Entwicklung: Weiterbildung und Austausch mit mehr als 60 anderen Softwareunternehmen der CHAPTERS Group.
Sport & Gesundheit: Geförderte Mitgliedschaft über den Urban Sports Club.

TWIST ist eine preisgekrönte Film und Fotoproduktion aus Düsseldorf. Seit 2020 machen wir Werbefilme, Imagefilme, Social Media Content und Eventfilme für Marken wie L'Oréal, NFL, Kerrygold und Burlington. Unser Leitsatz lautet Goosebumps never lie, denn wir machen Filme, die man spürt.
Was wir nach außen über uns erzählen, soll genauso viel Gänsehaut erzeugen wie unsere Produktionen. Deshalb suchen wir ab sofort eine Werkstudentin oder einen Werkstudenten für 20 Stunden pro Woche, die oder der das Marketing bei TWIST auf einen neuen Stand bringt und uns als Unternehmen sichtbarer und lauter macht.
Aufgaben

Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer Website, von neuen Referenzen bis zu aktuellen News
Betreuung unserer Social Media Kanäle und regelmäßiges Bespielen unserer Storys
Aufbau und Versand unseres Newsletters, um bestehende Kontakte aktiv zu halten und neue zu gewinnen
Eigenständige Planung, welche Vertriebskanäle wir nutzen und wie wir sie bespielen
Unterstützung im Recruiting, zum Beispiel bei Stellenanzeigen und unserem Auftritt als Arbeitgeber
Planung und Umsetzung von TWIST Merchandise und unseren legendären Ingwer-Shots
Organisation von Events für unser Team
Planung von Weiterbildungen für das Team
Pflege unserer Profile auf externen Portalen wie Crew United und auf Vergabeplattformen
Neue Ansätze und Inspiration einbringen, wie wir TWIST weiter platzieren und lauter machen können

Qualifikation

Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien oder einem ähnlichen Bereich
Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Social Media und weißt, was eine Story interessant macht
Du arbeitest eigenständig und strukturiert, wartest nicht auf Anweisungen und suchst dir Aufgaben selbst
Du hast Lust, Dinge auszuprobieren und neue Ideen aktiv vorzuschlagen
Du schreibst sicher und gern, idealerweise auf Deutsch und Englisch
Erfahrung mit Tools wie Canva, Adobe oder Newsletter Software ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
Du begeisterst dich für Film, Werbung und die Kreativbranche

Benefits

Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust das Marketing von TWIST aktiv mit auf
20 Stunden pro Woche mit flexibler Zeiteinteilung, abgestimmt auf dein Studium
Direkter Draht zum Gründer und kurze Entscheidungswege
Einblick in Film und Fotoproduktionen für namhafte Marken
Die Chance, preisgekrönte Projekte wie TWISTED Stories nach außen zu tragen
Office in Düsseldorf, in dem der Spaß und das Teamgefühl an erster Stelle stehen

Du musst noch kein Marketingprofi sein. Du solltest Lust haben, eine Filmproduktion sichtbar zu machen und dabei eigene Ideen umzusetzen. Wenn das nach dir klingt, schick uns deine Bewerbung und gern Links zu Kanälen oder Projekten, die du schon betreut hast. C'mon let's TWIST!

title: Multidisciplinary Studio Internship - Art, Engineering & Communication (Berlin)
description_clean:
Studio Apelbaum, founded by artist and engineer Jonathan Apelbaum, brings painting, technology, sound and people into the same space. Our work begins with stories of intimacy, memory and identity and grows through a team of makers, engineers, musicians, performers and writers. We are building a new 150 m² studio at Osloer Straße 16–17 in the historic Umspannwerk Christiania, with a workshop and our own exhibition space.
Our cognitive paintings are oil paintings whose images shift with light, movement and sound through custom LED systems and software. Building these paintings and building the new studio are equally important parts of the internship. Both ask us to work with our hands, solve problems together and learn across disciplines.
Our team crosses disciplines: Jonathan Apelbaum (painting and artistic direction), Thore Bartholomäus (co-owner and main engineer), James Calvert (mechanics and mechatronics), Fabian Wetekamp (software), Titouan Duflo (engineering, performance and AV), Clément Royon (music and soundscape) and malice. (a French collective from Clermont-Ferrand), Lucie Froehlich (fabrication and animation), Aysu Naz Atalay (writing), Valeria Loseva (building), and Alexandra Psijas (design). We also work with choreographer Matilde Flor Usinger and musician Forgotten Sounds to shape how an exhibition moves into the night.
Our own series of ambitious, invitation-only exhibitions and events is central to the new studio. We design and build adaptable furniture in steel and oak so the same room can hold work, an exhibition or a dinner. We make the artworks, shape the space, invite our guests and welcome them ourselves. With Clément Royon's music, an exhibition can slowly change its rhythm; with Forgotten Sounds, it can move into a party. This way of working grows from Jonathan's experience in queer and club culture. Beyond the studio, we create large installations with TRACEY (formerly Lunchbox Candy), Playground Festival and other art festivals.
How the internship works
We welcome engineers, programmers, makers, artists, writers and communicators. The internship has three connected parts:
1. We begin together with two equally important jobs: building the studio and building the cognitive paintings. Everyone joins the hands-on work, whatever their background. This includes renovating and making furniture as well as assembling, wiring and testing the paintings.
2. You take on one main studio project shaped around your skills, with guidance from the team. This can become the direction of a longer collaboration.
3. In May, we come together for a major exhibition. We will transform an entire building and take care of the experience from installation and invitations to welcoming guests.
Tasks

Build, assemble and test cognitive paintings and their LED systems
Build the studio with us, including custom steel and oak furniture and its adaptable exhibition and dining space
Contribute to research, prototypes, software, spatial design or storytelling according to your skills
Organise materials, tools, storage, artwork transport and installation in the studio and at external sites
Manage shipping lists, cost estimates, and customs documentation
Write or create invitations, exhibition texts, documentation and communication materials where relevant to your project
Assist in managing multiple ongoing projects
Occasionally travel as a courier for exhibition

Requirements

A practice or strong interest in engineering, programming, making, visual art, writing, communication or related fields
Ability to work independently and take initiative
Interest in contemporary art, installation, or performance
Curiosity about working across art, technology, production, storytelling and communication; you do not need to arrive with all these skills
Reliability, flexibility and care for both artworks and people

Benefits
You will learn within a diverse team that works like a chosen family, surrounded by a larger community. You will gain practical experience in electronics, steel and oak, and help shape our studio, intimate events and major May exhibition. Your own studio project gives you room to grow with us.

Duration: 6 months
Format: Part-time
Compensation: Unpaid

You must have paid work outside the studio—whether a job, freelance work or service work—to support yourself during this unpaid internship. An independent artistic project alongside is welcome, but optional. Within Studio Apelbaum, you will lead one main project agreed with and supported by the team.
The studio is a place to teach, learn and grow together. We are looking for people who want to stay with us. The internship is a first step, and the main project you take on here can become the direction of your future work in the studio.
Please send:

A motivation letter explaining your interest in the studio and the direction you would like to develop here (most important). If you have an independent artistic project, you can tell us about it too.
Your CV and/or portfolio (if available)

title: Revenue Operations Manager - Switzerland
description_clean: About the RoleNeural Concept's Revenue Operations function sits at the heart of how we scale commercially. Bridging Sales, Finance, and GTM Strategy, you will drive the operational engine behind our revenue growth — ensuring that every deal we pursue, every resource we allocate, and every commercial decision we make is grounded in data, financial discipline, and operational precision.As RevOps Manager, you will partner directly with our Finance Director to build and run the commercial infrastructure that powers our growth. You will own revenue forecasting, GTM analytics, sales process design, and the systems that make our commercial teams faster and smarter. This is not a back-office role — it is a strategic seat at the table, working side by side with Sales, Finance, and Leadership to turn data into decisions and friction into performance.Neural Concept is on a mission to transform how the world's leading engineering organisations design products, with AI at the centre of product development. At Series C, with 120+ people and 60+ global OEM customers across automotive, aerospace, semiconductors, and defence, we are scaling fast. This is a chance to build the revenue engine of a company that is reshaping an entire industry and work within AI with concrete and tangible real-life outcomes.What you will doRevenue Forecasting & Commercial Analytics — Own and maintain revenue forecasting models integrated with financial planning cycles, working closely with the Finance Director. Build and manage dashboards tracking ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, win rates, and commercial KPIs across segments and geographies. Develop financial scenarios to support pricing decisions, headcount planning, and growth investments. Translate commercial data into executive-ready insights and actionable recommendations for GTM leadership.GTM Systems & Technology Ownership — Own and continuously optimise the RevOps tech stack (CRM, BI, CPQ, enrichment, and revenue intelligence tools), ensuring data integrity, system hygiene, and seamless integration across platforms. Proactively identify, evaluate, and deploy AI-powered tools to streamline lead routing, pipeline management, contract workflows, and reporting. Partner with Sales and Marketing and IT and Systems teams to automate processes and eliminate manual work across the commercial funnel.Sales Process Design & Operational Excellence — Design, document, and continuously improve end-to-end sales processes, from lead qualification through to contract signature and customer handover. Define and enforce deal desk workflows, including approval processes, commercial terms governance, and exception management. Work closely with Sales leadership to identify and remove operational friction slowing pipeline velocity.Commercial Finance Partnership — Serve as the primary bridge between the GTM team and Finance, ensuring commercial data flows accurately into financial models, planning cycles, and board reporting. Support quota setting, territory planning, and commission model design in close partnership with the Finance Director and Sales leadership. Build financial models to evaluate the ROI of commercial initiatives, GTM experiments, and market expansion scenarios.Go-to-Market Planning & Cross-functional Alignment — Lead annual and quarterly GTM planning, including territory design, segmentation, capacity planning, and resource allocation. Coordinate across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Finance to ensure alignment on targets, timelines, and priorities. Own and evolve the commercial data model, from ICP definition and account segmentation to revenue attribution and performance benchmarking.Who you are5+ years of progressive experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Commercial Finance, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or deep-tech environments.Proven track record of building or scaling a RevOps function with measurable impact on revenue outcomes — from improved forecast accuracy and stronger pipeline conversion, to reduced sales cycle length.Advanced finance background — you are comfortable with financial modelling, P&L analysis, revenue recognition, and working directly alongside Finance Directors or CFOs. You bring the rigour of a finance professional to a commercial and sales-focused context.Deep CRM expertise (Salesforce or HubSpot) — demonstrated ability to administer, optimise, and scale CRM systems to support a growing GTM team without relying on external technical support.Proficient in BI and analytics tools and strong Excel or Google Sheets financial modelling skills.Strong commercial acumen — you understand the mechanics of enterprise sales cycles, deal structures, pipeline health, pricing models, and revenue retention, and you translate that understanding into sharp operational decisions.Genuinely technology-savvy — you actively seek out and deploy AI tools to automate, improve, and accelerate your work. You are comfortable evaluating new platforms, running pilots, and embedding technology into operational workflows. You see AI as a fundamental lever for RevOps, not a nice-to-have.Excellent cross-functional communicator — you translate complex data and process design into clear, compelling narratives for Sales, Finance, and C-suite audiences.Entrepreneurial mindset — you thrive with ambiguity, take proactive ownership, and are energised by building in environments where the playbook does not yet exist.Nice to have: experience in enterprise software, AI, or deep-tech companies; familiarity with CPQ tools, revenue intelligence platforms, or contract management systems; experience designing variable compensation and commission structures.What You Get Work with a world-class technology team –  we always aim for excellence.Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.Make a global impact, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules. title: InnoMaster Big Data Engineering - part-time Master's Program
description_clean:
Part-time Master's Program starting April 2027
 
Do you have a passion for Big Data? Do you want to make your Master studies exciting and practical? Do you wish to continue studying after your Bachelor's degree while simultaneously stepping into the professional world? And all this with a fixed monthly salary and complete coverage of tuition fees? Then, our InnoMaster Program is just right for you!
 
As part of the InnoMaster Big Data Engineering Program, you'll typically study alongside your job at a university offering an accredited part-time Master's program in IT/Data Engineering located in Hamburg or its surroundings (e.g. FH Wedel), and we'll cover the costs for you! Concurrently, you'll gain valuable practical work experience working within various Big Data environments such as Google Cloud and on-site Hadoop, allowing you to apply your theoretical knowledge directly into practice! Support our Data Engineers and Data Scientists in processing, managing, and analyzing our data. In addition to responsible tasks and appropriate compensation, we offer participation in training sessions (related to the field, programming languages, or soft skills) and support in further career development.
 
The InnoMaster Big Data Engineering program is designed for approximately three years, with a weekly workload of 25-40 hours depending on your university schedule. We are happy to assist if you have further questions regarding the program.
 Your skill set
Bachelor degree. You have completed your IT-related bachelor's or diploma studies with good grades (GPA of 2.5 or better).
Admission requirements. You meet the admission requirements of your preferred IT or data-related program at a university in the Hamburg area.
Data engineering. Your personal software projects reflect your affinity for software development and data engineering.
Big Data. You have an interest in Big Data ecosystems, some experience with Java and Python is a plus.
Soft skills. You enjoy working independently with a strong team-oriented mentality; demonstrate a high level of self-initiative and quick comprehension.
English as our company language. You look forward to using your excellent English skills in both spoken and written form daily.
Your power-ups
Team of specialists. Be part of a stable, growing, and award-winning global company. Meet your future colleagues in Development & IT in this video.
Perfect learning environment. We offer you an extremely interesting technical environment and state-of-the-art working conditions.
Career development. We support your professional and personal development with optimal guidance from a contact person in the department and from People & Culture.
Monthly salary plus education costs. We finance your full tuition fees, including books, plus a monthly salary of € 2.531,- gross per month.
Outstanding equipment. You work with a fully equipped MacBook Pro, and we provide you with a smartphone or tablet of your choice.
Agile work. You can expect flexible working hours and agile, cross-functional teams with short decision-making paths.
Team events. Participate in regular team events (e.g., wine tasting, cooking, paintball), barbecue together on our rooftop terrace, and enjoy regular company-get-togethers.
Comfy and modern office. We offer you various possibilities to combine work and well-being: fresh fruit and complimentary drinks, in-house fitness studio, gaming area, rooftop terrace with BBQ, relaxing rooms, and much more.
InnoGames is one of the leading German developers and publishers of mobile and browser games and a certified Great Place to Work®. The Hamburg-based company was founded in 2007 and is now part of Modern Times Group (MTG). Together with about 350 employees from 40 nations, the company founders develop unique games that provide many years of fun for millions of players around the world. InnoGames is best known for Forge of Empires, Elvenar and Tribal Wars, but the company is continually expanding its now 10-game portfolio across platforms and genres. Most recently, InnoGames launched Heroes of History, a novel mix of city builder and hero collection RPG and Cozy Coast, a feel-good beach adventure with elaborate merge-2-gameplay and a captivating story

title: Product Manager, Courier Delivery Experience
description_clean:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.We seek a Product Manager to join our Courier and Delivery Experience (CDX) team. This role will focus on ensuring world-class courier and consumer delivery experiences while continually evolving the delivery process with a future-oriented mindset. The Courier and Delivery Experience team owns the experiences that elevate every Wolt delivery, from the moment a courier opens the app to every order they accept, all the way to dropping an order off at the customer's doorstep. The team sits at the intersection of a multi-sided marketplace product, real-world operations, and safety, and the work directly moves how reliable Wolt feels to consumers and how satisfied our couriers are when delivering.
You will play a crucial role in shaping the courier experience, ensuring that our couriers feel valued and supported while enhancing the efficiency of deliveries. By blending operational expertise with a deep understanding of courier needs, you will improve the user journey from onboarding couriers to completing deliveries. From designing new features that boost courier satisfaction to refining delivery processes, your work will contribute to key metrics across courier engagement, performance, and satisfaction. You will also be influential in shaping the evolution of the live delivery experience for our courier partners, the merchant courier interaction at pickup and the consumer courier interaction at the doorstep via the Courier app surfaces. 
The ideal candidate will have an exceptional track record in product management, with proven success in working with cross-functional teams across engineering, design, product, and operations. You will define the vision and roadmap for courier and delivery experiences across multiple projects. Working in partnership with business stakeholders, you will also collaborate on cross-team initiatives, contributing to the broader business strategy while ensuring a deep understanding of the courier experience.
Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.
Our humble expectations
You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

Several years of experience in product management, specializing in consumer-facing products
Expertise in developing user-centric products, with the ability to address complex user experience-related challenges.
Demonstrated expertise in supporting cross-functional teams and fostering operational excellence in fast-paced, high-demand industries.
Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under itTurn the data into something users act onDefine the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screenOwn our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is whichSet the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anywayOwn the numbersDefine the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retentionRun the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what didLive in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to youWhat we are looking forYou might be a fit if:You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description_clean: The product you will work onThe HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.The ideal candidate isWe are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte.Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. AI-forward mindset, ruthless prioritization and consistent, clear verbal and written communication with stakeholders in English

Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting to change in a fast-moving, scaling environment

Experience working in international teams

Based in Germany.

Broad mandate across customers, product, and the company—not a siloed role.
Your feedback and work show up quickly in how Norman grows.

We are smartmicro, the leading specialist in high-performance automotive and traffic radar- and radar/camera hybrid sensor technology. We design, develop and manufacture high-tech sensors for autonomous driving, intelligent traffic infrastructure and smart cities. Our mission is to make roads safer, enable autonomous driving in all-weather scenarios, optimize traffic flow for reduced travel times and enable greener, smarter cities.

We make the future of mobility a reality.
We are looking for an experienced Algorithm Engineer for Radar Tracking.
Your Tasks
In this role, you develop tracking and sensor fusion algorithms for radar and camera-based sensor systems used in intelligent traffic systems, smart mobility, ADAS-related applications, automated driving scenarios and airborne radar applications.

You develop, implement and validate algorithms for multi-object tracking, sensor fusion and statistical signal processing
You work on advanced tracking approaches such as extended object tracking, Bernoulli filters, Kalman filters, Bayesian filtering, probabilistic data association and related estimation methods
You work with real radar, camera and radar/camera fusion data and analyze algorithm performance in realistic traffic, mobility and airborne scenarios
You turn algorithmic concepts, prototypes and proof-of-concepts into robust, maintainable and testable software for product development and customer projects
You improve robustness, accuracy, runtime behavior and reliability of tracking and fusion algorithms under challenging real-world conditions
You define and use suitable test cases, metrics and validation methods to evaluate detection, tracking, fusion and object-level perception quality
Depending on the project, your work may contribute to applications such as intelligent traffic infrastructure, ADAS, automated driving, drone detection, UAV/UAS tracking and airborne radar systems.
You cooperate closely with embedded software, system engineering, testing and product teams to ensure reliable integration into our sensor platforms
Your work contributes to safety-critical and high-performance radar applications, for example by improving traffic flow, protecting vulnerable road users and enabling robust radar-based perception in airborne use cases

Your Strengths
We are looking for an engineer with proven professional experience in algorithm development, not only an academic background.

You have completed a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Mathematics or a comparable technical field
You have some years of full-time professional experience in industrial or commercial algorithm/software development after graduation (Internships, thesis work, student jobs and purely university-based projects do not count toward this requirement)
You have practical experience with at least one of the following areas: multi-object tracking, sensor fusion, radar tracking, object-level fusion, nonlinear state estimation, statistical signal processing, perception algorithms or probabilistic methods
You are confident in programming with Python and C or C++ and can write structured, maintainable and testable code
You have a solid mathematical foundation, especially in linear algebra, statistics, probability theory, estimation theory and filtering methods
Experience with radar systems, camera systems, automotive sensors, ADAS, automated driving, intelligent traffic systems, embedded systems, real-time applications, drone tracking, UAV/UAS applications, airborne radar or radar altimeters is a strong advantage
Knowledge of tracking methods such as Kalman filters, EKF, UKF, particle filters, JPDA, MHT, Bernoulli filters, PHD filters or extended object tracking is beneficial
You are able to analyze complex technical problems independently and convert your findings into reliable software solutions
You work in a structured, delivery-oriented way and can balance technical quality with project constraints.
You communicate clearly in English; German language skills are an advantage

title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
description_clean:
Your mission
About L1VE
L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 12K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.
As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth.
Your Role
As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models.
You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.
In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.
Your Responsibilities

Develop and implement L1VE’s finance architecture for Germany and Europe, with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability
Own integrated financial planning, budgeting, business cases, financial models, forecasts and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making
Build and further develop relevant KPI systems for Technology, Commercial, Product, Marketing and Sales
Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships, licensing models and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications
Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO
Manage and further develop management, investor and partner reporting based on reliable and auditable data and processes
Coordinate interfaces with Finance Administration, Accounting, Tax, Audit, Legal and other external finance partners
Further develop finance, reporting and governance structures, as well as the systems and processes supporting them

Your profile

At least seven years of relevant professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role – ideally combining experience in a demanding consulting or Big Four environment with hands-on experience in a startup, scale-up or growth company
Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modelling, forecasting and management reporting
Strong knowledge of controlling, business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options
Understanding of German commercial, tax and corporate law requirements, as well as experience managing external professional advisors
Ideally, experience in the media, entertainment, sports rights, streaming, subscription or digital B2C environment, including licensing and revenue-share models
Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage
Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments
Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership
Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created
Excellent written and spoken German and English, as well as confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools

Why us?

You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.
You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.
You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.


Interested?
Please send us your CV along with a short cover letter or a few sentences outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Head of Finance role.
We look forward to hearing from you!

Turn review insights into clear, actionable suggestions for product improvements and share them with the product team.
Use review feedback to help improve our product content and the way we communicate around our products, feeding suggestions to the content team.
Flag relevant review themes to the marketing team to help shape messaging and campaigns.
Act as a central point for review management, coordinating feedback between the product, content and marketing teams.
Support the marketplace managers on execution projects, such as updating and optimising product listings.
Help out on a range of smaller tasks and projects across the team wherever an extra hand is needed.
Keep samples, records, trackers and documentation well organised and up to date.

Currently enrolled at a German university in a related discipline with at least 12 months of enrollment remaining.

Proactive and collaborative mindset, with excellent communication skills and a willingness to work closely with cross-functional teams.


Reliable, accountable, and self-motivated, with the initiative to take ownership of tasks and drive them to completion.


Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.


Proficient in Microsoft Excel and comfortable learning new tools and systems.

Fluency in English is essential; German language skills are a plus.

Comfortable working for a brand that communicates openly and confidently about sexual wellness.

Reporting: Aufbau und Pflege von Reportings zur transparenten Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Erfolge der Kampagnen für den Kunden.
Amazon Seller Central: Nutzung und Verwaltung des Amazon Seller Central zur Überwachung und Steuerung von Kampagnen.
PPC-Optimierung: Anpassung und Optimierung der PPC-Preise auf Basis zuvor festgelegter Strategien, um die Effizienz und den ROI der Werbemaßnahmen zu maximieren.

Qualifikation

Kaufmännische Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Kaufmann/-frau für E-Commerce oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich.
Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bist in der Lage, Aufgaben effizient und selbstständig zu bewältigen.
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themenfelder einzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen.
Team- und Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist in der Lage, dich klar und präzise schriftlich sowie mündlich zu äußern.

Strukturierte Kommunikation: Deine schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation ist klar und gut organisiert.
Technisches Know-how: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint gehören zu deinem Repertoire, um Kampagnenanalysen und Präsentationen professionell zu erstellen.

Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.

Deine Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Sexualität oder Geschlecht sind dabei keine Auswahlkriterien. Sei du selbst und wachse mit uns. Welcome to the Goodlife!Deine Aufgaben bei unsDu hast Lust, unseren HEJ TikTok-Kanal weiter aufzubauen und dabei richtig kreativ zu werden? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig: Du entwickelst eigene Ideen, planst Videoskripte und setzt sie direkt um – von der ersten Skizze bis zum finalen Edit liegt der Content in deinen Händen.Du entwickelst kreative Videoformate, die TikTok lieben könnte – snackable, schnell, authentisch.Du drehst eigene kurze Videos zu Produkten, BTS-Moments, Team-Life und Community-Formaten.Du schneidest deinen Content selbst und bringst ihn auf FYP-Level.Du hast TikTok im Blut: Trends erkennst du früh und verwandelst sie in HEJ-relevante Ideen – und bringst sie aktiv ins wöchentliche Redaktionsmeeting ein.Du erfindest mit Leichtigkeit eigene kreative Konzepte, Stories und Hooks, die hängen bleiben.Du planst deine Content- und Videoideen passend zu unseren Launch- und Aktionsplanungen in einem Redaktionsplan.Du testest verschiedene Formate, analysierst, was funktioniert – und optimierst kontinuierlich weiter.Du bereitest monatliche Performance- und Content-Reportings auf.Als Teil des Teams arbeitest eng mit dem Content & Communications Kolleginnen zusammen, damit alles zur Marke passt und dein Content auf Kampagnen und Markenbotschaften abgestimmt ist.Dein ProfilDu bist idealerweise kürzlich mit deinem Master-Studiengang mit Bezug zu Medien, Kommunikation, Marketing, Design oder Film gestartet und suchst eine andauernde Werkstudierendentätigkeit neben deinem Studium.Du lebst TikTok nicht nur, sondern verstehst, warum ein Video funktioniert – Hook, Pacing, Sound, Trend-Timing.Erste Praxis als Content Creator:in bringst du über deinen eigenen Kanal oder schon aus einem Unternehmenskontext mit.Du bist sicher im Videoschnitt, etwa mit CapCut, und bringst idealerweise Grundkenntnisse in Videoproduktion mit, von Kamera über Licht bis Ton – oder bist ambitioniert, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.Vor der Kamera bist du in deinem Element, selbstsicher, authentisch, nahbar für deine Community.Du kommunizierst klar und sicher auf Deutsch – deine Community folgt dir gerne, und auch die Abstimmung mit dem Content & Communications Team läuft reibungslos.Ideen sprudeln bei dir von selbst – statt Bestehendes zu kopieren, probierst du gerne Neues aus und gehst dabei auch mal eigene Wege.Trotz kreativem Kopfchaos planst, priorisierst und lieferst du zuverlässig und eigenverantwortlich ab – Selbstorganisation und Umsetzungsstärke sind für dich selbstverständlich.Ein Plus: Verlinke uns gerne deinen Kanal und /oder sende uns gerne ein kurzes Video von dir, in dem wir dich und deine Liebe zur Kamera schon ein wenig kennenlernen dürfen. description_clean: Deine RolleDie Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet. Uns ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit wichtig, daher ist eine Übernahme in eine unbefristete Anstellung angestrebt.Als Campaign Manager*in bist du das Herzstück unserer Kundenprojekte: Du verbindest kreatives Marketing, strategische Beratung und operative Exzellenz, um Top-Brands und Arbeitgeber perfekt auf unserer Plattform und Social Media zu inszenieren. Dabei bist du für folgende Themenschwerpunkte verantwortlich:End-to-End Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst, betreust und wickelst Werbekampagnen für unsere Kunden und Agenturen ab. Von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung hast du das Heft fest in der Hand.Multichannel-Setup & Operations: Du setzt Kampagnen zeitgerecht in unseren eigenen Inhouse-Tools sowie auf Social Media um und managst flexibel Umbuchungen oder Stornierungen.Employer Branding & Jobbörse: Du betreust Employer-Branding-Kampagnen unserer Partner, legst zielgruppenstarke Stellenanzeigen an und verwaltest diese passgenau auf unserer StudySmarter Jobbörse, um Arbeitgeber optimal bei der Gen Z zu positionieren.Kreativ-Workflows & Design-Beratung: Du berätst unsere Kunden zur visuellen Gestaltung und Zielgruppenansprache, erstellst Mailings und baust ansprechende Kundenprofile auf.Sales-Schnittstelle & Support: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, bildest die Schnittstelle zu allen vertriebsrelevanten Bereichen und unterstützt aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung von Marketing- und Vertriebsaktionen.Data-driven After-Sales: Du analysierst die Kampagnen-Performance, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und präsentierst die Ergebnisse überzeugend vor unseren Kunden.Was du für diese Rolle brauchstBackground: Idealerweise hast du erste praktische Erfahrung im Online-Marketing, einer (Media-)Agentur, im HR-Marketing/Employer Branding oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld – auch motivierte Quereinsteiger*innen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen!Kommunikationsstärke: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie echte Freude am direkten, beratenden Kundenkontakt.Organisationstalent: Ein hervorragendes Zeitmanagement, tiefes Verständnis für die unterschiedlichen B2B-Kundenbedürfnisse.Mindset: Hohe Eigenmotivation, der Wille zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und die Leidenschaft, ein stark wachsendes title: Working Student Global Licensing (DACH) (all genders)
description_clean: Über tonies:tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat die Art und Weise, wie kleine Kinder unabhängig spielen und lernen, durch seinen kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz verändert. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert, und das Portfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht, darunter die Börsennotierung an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein global aufgestelltes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren.Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, an einer inspirierenden Mission mitzuwirken: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie.Du als Teil von tonies:Bei Tonies Licensing haben wir es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Magie von Audio zu Kindern überall auf der Welt zu bringen. Wir suchen eine motivierte und begeisterte Studentische Nachwuchskraft (m/w/d), die unser Portfolio an globalen Lizenzkonten unterstützt und dabei hilft, internationale Lizenzprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Produktlaunch voranzutreiben. Diese Rolle ist perfekt für jemanden, der wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem kommerziell ausgerichteten Umfeld sammeln möchte – an der Seite eines Teams, das Beziehungen zu großen internationalen Lizenzgebern der Spielzeug- und Unterhaltungsbranche in Nordamerika und der EMEA-Region betreut.Deine Aufgaben umfassen:Unterstützung im Lizenzmanagement: Du unterstützt das Lizenz-Team bei der Pflege und Koordination der Beziehungen zu internationalen Lizenzpartnern.Mitarbeit an internationalen Projekten: Du begleitest internationale Lizenzprojekte über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von den ersten Gesprächen über den Vertragsabschluss bis hin zur Produktentwicklung und dem Marktstart.Kaufmännische Unterstützung: Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Pflege von Lizenz-GuVs (Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen) und unterstützt bei der Ausarbeitung von Berichten sowie Präsentationen für interne Stakeholder.Schnittstellenkoordination: Du unterstützt die Kommunikation zwischen internen Fachbereichen (z. B. Produktentwicklung, Marketing, Recht, Finanzen) und externen Lizenzagenturen oder -partnern.Markt- & Branchenrecherche: Du recherchierst aktuelle Trends sowie Entwicklungen in der globalen Lizenz- und Unterhaltungsbranche und bereitest die Ergebnisse für das Team auf.Was wir uns von dir wünschen:Studium: Immatrikulierte/r Student/in, idealerweise in Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), Medienmanagement, Kommunikationswissenschaften oder einem verwandten Studiengang.Brancheninteresse: Erste Berührungspunkte mit oder Interesse an der globalen Spielzeug- und Unterhaltungsindustrie.Zahlenaffinität: Grundlegendes Verständnis kaufmännischer Konzepte sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit Excel und Berichten.Vorerfahrung von Vorteil: Praktika oder Tätigkeiten als Werkstudent/in im Bereich Lizenzierung, Marketing oder Business Development sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss.Kommunikationsstärke: Gute Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch sowie ein selbstsicheres Auftreten im Kontakt mit externen Partnern.Persönlichkeit: Proaktive, strukturierte und lernbegierige Persönlichkeit, die gerne eigenverantwortlich arbeitet und sich in einem internationalen, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlt.Warum tonies?Globales Teamwork: Wir arbeiten über Abteilungs- und Ländergrenzen hinweg an unserer Vision, die Toniebox in jedes Kinderzimmer der Welt zu bringen.Come as you are: Das gilt nicht nur für den Dresscode, sondern für alles andere auch. Denn nur wo du dich wirklich wohlfühlst, kannst du dein Bestes geben.Sprachen lernen & Entspannung: Verbessere deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Sprachlern-App Babbel und finde Entspannung durch unseren Zugang zur Meditations-App Calm.Urlaubspaket: Genieße 30 Tage Jahresurlaub (basierend auf einer 5-Tage-Woche) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend, Silvester und Rosenmontag.tonies-Rabatt: Shoppe mit Rabatten in unserem tonies-Onlineshop.Corporate Benefits: Erhalte Zugriff auf weitere Mitarbeiter-Rabatte über unser Corporate-Benefits-Portal.Gut zu wissen:Bei tonies® sind Inklusion und Vielfalt fest in unseren Grundprinzipien verankert. Wir schätzen die vielfältigen Talente, Hintergründe, Überzeugungen und Geschlechtsidentitäten, die unter unserem Dach zusammenkommen. Jedes Gesicht ist willkommen, und wir unterstützen jeden Menschen in allen Phasen seiner Entwicklung bei uns.Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!Ketsia DinzalaPeople & Culture Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager - Experience Above the Box (all genders)
description_clean: About tonies:tonies is the globally leading interactive audio platform for children with more than 10 million Tonieboxes and 125 million Tonies sold. The intuitive and award-winning audio system has changed the way young children play and learn independently with its child-safe, wireless, and screen-free approach. Tonieboxes have been activated in over 100 countries, the content portfolio includes around 1,400 Tonies in several languages. Since its inception, tonies has achieved significant milestones, including listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in November 2021 as well as a globally present team of over 550 dedicated professionals operating from various countries.Joining our tonies team means being part of an inspiring mission to create innovative and meaningful experiences for children around the world. Together, we’re shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.You as part of tonies:Above the box is where the magic of tonies becomes tangible: the Tonies themselves — Content, Creative, Clever — and Tonieplay. As Engineering Manager (all genders) for our Above-the-Box value stream, you lead a cross-functional team that owns these experiences end to end — from the device through App and cloud, across every Toniebox generation and every device our products will run on next.The team is newly formed and set to grow, with a mix of internal and external engineers. Together with your Product Manager, you shape both the experiences we ship and the team that builds them, bringing joy to millions of children worldwide. Ready to help us create the future of audio play?Your tasks and responsibilities will include:Team Leadership: You nurture the professional growth of your engineers and build a culture where inclusive mentorship, continuous learning, and high collaboration are the norm — across disciplines, and across internal and external team members alike.Building & Scaling the Team: You grow the team as our roadmap grows: shaping the profiles we hire, onboarding and integrating external engineers, and making sure critical knowledge stays with the team rather than walking out the door.End-to-End Ownership: You make your team genuinely accountable for its experiences — embedded, app, and cloud — rather than handing work over at team boundaries.Architectural Oversight: You oversee the structural integrity of the Above-the-Box implementations, ensuring a consistent user experience across multiple device generations through clean abstractions and cross-functional end-to-end ownership.Interfaces & Dependencies: You define the application-level APIs your team needs from our platform teams and turn cross-team dependencies into clear, testable contracts instead of coordination overhead.Product Sync & Strategy: You synchronise with Product Management to prioritise features and technical debt, ensuring that every engineering cycle directly fuels the overarching tonies® product vision.Leading Through Change: You bring the team through transitions with a clear vision, identifying what needs to improve and driving those improvements together with your engineers.Technical Credibility & Hands-on Depth: You stay close enough to the code to run high-impact reviews, challenge architectural decisions, and step in on critical problems — so our quality standards remain uncompromised, including for work delivered by external partners.Delivery Excellence: You manage the end-to-end delivery process, applying lean principles to streamline workflows and ensure stable, plannable, reliable releases for our customers.Your Team's ResponsibilitiesDesigning, building, and maintaining the Above-the-Box experience — our value stream covering everything our users experience beyond the box itself:Content-, Creative- and Clever ToniesTonieplayDelivering these experiences across the full stack, from on-device software through app and cloud servicesSpecifying the abstract interfaces (APIs) delivered by our lower-level platform teams, so the team can own its experiences end to end across hardware generationsSafeguarding quality through end-to-end ownership and test automation owned inside the teamPartnering closely with Product Management to translate the experience roadmap into sustainable deliveryActing as the point of contact for Above-the-Box topics across the wider engineering organisationWhat we are looking for:Leadership & Team Empowerment: You have experience leading engineering teams—including specialists outside your own discipline—and excel at turning complex challenges into a clear vision. title: Principal Brand Designer (Spain or Portugal - based role)
description_clean:
About the Role
At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.
Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.
Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.
You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.
What you'll ownDefine the future of OLX’s  Group's brand ecosystem
Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.


Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards


Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles


Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries


Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)


Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets. 


Build scalable creative systems powered by AI
You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.
Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.
You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.
Raise the creative standard across OLX Group
As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across  product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.
You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.
Translate strategy into brand experiences
You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.
You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.
Drive adoption and influence across the organisation
Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.
You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.
You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.
Mentor and elevate the craft
As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.
You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.What we're looking forWe're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.
You create brands that people trust 
Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.
You think in systems 
You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.
You bring strategy to life through Design 
You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.
You're fluent in AI-enabled Design
You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.
You influence without authority
You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.
You bring depth of experience
You'll likely have:


10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design


Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets


Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite


Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences


Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems


Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows


Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX
OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.
As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.
This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.
If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

Lead product design for a defined area across mobile and web.
Turn complex financial and credit-related information into experiences that feel simple, useful and trustworthy.
Plan and conduct customer research, interviews and usability testing, particularly with German-speaking users.
Translate qualitative research and behavioural data into clear product decisions.
Create user flows, interaction models, prototypes and polished product experiences in Figma.
Work closely with Engineering to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable and implemented with high quality.
Partner with Product and Data to define what success looks like and evaluate the impact of shipped work.
Contribute to and improve reusable patterns and our design system.
Use AI practically in your day-to-day work to accelerate research, exploration, prototyping and documentation.
Help shape AI-powered customer experiences where relevant — while applying strong judgement around trust, clarity and user control.
Share your expertise, give thoughtful feedback and help raise the quality of design across the team.

You have around 6–8 years of experience in product design, ideally working on digital consumer products.
Availability for a fixed 32 hours per week (80%)
Strong experience designing end-to-end product experiences across mobile and web.
Advanced skills in Figma, interaction design and prototyping.
Strong hands-on user research experience — not only consuming research, but planning and conducting it yourself.
The ability to simplify complex, data-heavy or sensitive topics into clear customer experiences.
Strong product thinking and the ability to connect design decisions to customer and business outcomes.
Experience working closely with Product, Engineering and Data in cross-functional teams.
Confidence working independently and taking ownership from ambiguity through delivery.
German at C1 level or above, including the ability to conduct customer interviews and usability studies.
Strong practical experience using AI tools in your design workflow — for example in exploration, synthesis, prototyping or documentation.
A collaborative, kind and constructive working style.
Experience in fintech, banking, financial services or another regulated/data-intensive environment is a strong plus.

The opportunity to take ownership from day one

30 vacation days

Fünf Bereiche, ein Ziel: Unsere Kunden sollen merken, dass bei uns alles organisiert ist.

Ab diesem Moment sorgst du dafür, dass organisatorisch alles steht: Teilnehmer anlegen, Gruppen zuordnen, Termine verschicken, WhatsApp-Gruppen vorbereiten sowie Zugänge zu Learning Suite, CARvinci und Persönlichkeitsanalysen koordinieren. Der Kunde soll nicht hinter Informationen herlaufen müssen.
Zwölf Monate Coaching im Blick behalten – Unsere Programme laufen über ein Jahr. Teilnehmer wechseln, Termine stehen an, Informationen müssen raus und Unterlagen rechtzeitig bereitliegen. Du behältst Gruppen, Termine, Zugänge, Teilnehmerwechsel, Zertifikate und offene Punkte im Blick – und sorgst dafür, dass nichts verloren geht.

Du arbeitest unter anderem mit Airtable, Excel, Learning Suite, ChatGPT und weiteren digitalen Tools.
Live-Trainings vorbereiten – In Münster organisierst du gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Live-Coachings: Teilnehmerlisten, Namensschilder, Unterlagen, Analysen, Raum und Technik. Und du packst selbst mit an. Du kennst unsere Kunden dadurch nicht nur aus einer Datenbank, sondern siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit möglich macht.

description_clean:
Job Description

✨ A little about us
Container xChange is building the distribution channel for global container trading.
We operate in a huge, fragmented and still highly inefficient market. Our ambition is to make it dramatically easier to access the right inventory, compare opportunities, transact and fulfil container purchases across sellers and locations globally.
To win, we need to get a few things exceptionally right: more of the right containers, in the right locations, at better prices — from sellers who are fast, reliable and easy to trade with.
That is where you come in.
🧭 The Role
As Product Engineer – Procurement, you will own our Procurement function end-to-end in close collaboration with our CEO Christian.
This is a hands-on commercial builder role: you run Procurement, improve the economics, and build the processes, automations and product solutions that make the function scale.
You will start hands-on: run day-to-day procurement, work directly with sellers, negotiate prices and promotions, support Sales on supply opportunities and understand where our current processes work well — and where they break.
But your mandate goes further: Build a Procurement function that becomes a competitive advantage for xChange.
We want you to constantly ask: How can we improve the economics? How can we make this process faster? What can we standardize? What can we automate?
You will use Claude and other tools to build lightweight solutions yourself, experiment with deterministic and agentic automation, and work closely with Engineering where solutions need to become part of our core product.
Over time, repetitive operational work should decrease while your focus on Seller Performance, Procurement strategy, automation and product improvements grows.
📍 Location
This is a position based in Hamburg, where you will work closely with our Sales, Product and Engineering team as well as directly with our CEO Christian.
Requirements
🚀 Your Impact
Ultimately, your work should help xChange transact more containers at better margins, while allowing Procurement to scale without scaling manual work at the same rate.
You will:

Own and run day-to-day Procurement and tactical Seller Management, using what you learn from operating the processes yourself to continuously improve, streamline and automate the function.
Improve our buying economics and Seller Performance by identifying pricing opportunities, negotiating with sellers, driving promotions and improving listing quality, reply speed, release speed and reliability.
Use Claude and other tools as part of your day-to-day work to solve problems faster and improve our processes and systems.
Build lightweight, bootstrapped solutions yourself when they can solve an immediate problem — from deterministic workflows to agentic solutions.
Work closely with Engineering when those solutions need to become more robust, scalable or part of our core product.
Build a more systematic, data-driven view of Procurement, so we can identify and prioritize the biggest opportunities across our seller portfolio.
Drive larger strategic initiatives such as gatebuy, future pickups and new ways of sourcing inventory that help us build a structurally better trading engine.

🌟 What Makes You a Great Fit?
We are looking for someone who combines commercial intuition, strong execution and a product/automation mindset.
You are likely a great fit if you:

Get genuine satisfaction from negotiating a better deal and spotting commercial opportunities others might miss.
Have a passion for trading, pricing and markets — whether that comes from work, the stock market, sports betting or simply how you think.
Are commercially confident enough to own seller relationships, make decisions independently and push back when needed.
Perform well under pressure and at speed — matching the pace of Sales without sacrificing accuracy.
Are highly structured and operationally reliable: fast without becoming sloppy.
Enjoy getting your hands dirty and executing the work yourself.
Think beyond individual cases and naturally ask how a process can be improved at a system level.
Can balance short-term execution with long-term improvement — improving processes, automation and scalability over time.
Are data-driven and comfortable using metrics to identify opportunities.
Already use AI to solve real-world problems and are excited about building prototypes, workflows and automations.
Can translate a business problem into something Engineering can work with.
Have strong ownership, drive and the learning velocity to grow further into product and automation.

You do not need to be a software engineer. We care much more about your ability to understand a problem deeply, imagine a better solution, prototype where possible and collaborate effectively with Engineers.
Deep container knowledge and traditional Procurement experience are also not prerequisites.
This role might not be for you if…

You prefer having perfect information before making decisions — this role requires fast judgment under uncertainty.
You don’t enjoy working in a high-pressure, fast-moving commercial environment where Procurement needs to match the pace of Sales.
You prefer staying at one level of the problem rather than switching between what needs to happen now, what needs to change commercially, and what needs to improve in the process or product.
You prefer clearly bounded responsibilities over end-to-end ownership — we expect you to take decisions, push back on sellers when needed, and stay accountable until the issue is actually resolved.

👀 What to Expect

A rare combination of commercial and product ownership: You will understand and improve the full Procurement system — from the economics of individual trades to the processes and technology behind the function.
A role that evolves with you: You will initially spend significant time running Procurement hands-on. As you improve and automate the function, your role should increasingly shift toward Seller Performance, Procurement economics, product and automation.
Direct exposure to the business: You will work closely with our CEO Christian and have direct visibility into how supply, pricing and seller performance translate into containers transacted and margin.
Build rather than inherit: You are not joining a mature Procurement function with a fixed playbook. You will help define how Procurement at xChange should work in the future, from how we manage sellers today to how much of the function can eventually be automated.
AI as a real working tool: We expect you to use tools such as Claude to increase your own leverage and continuously challenge which parts of your job still need to be done manually.
The long-term opportunity is to help build a Procurement engine that becomes one of xChange’s core competitive advantages.
